units: <cite ref="Menachot 65a:12">Men. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>חוץ מזקן אחד שהיה מְפַטְפֵּט כנגדו</he> except one old man who talked (childishly) against him.

senses.gloss: פ׳ ביצרו to talk or argue with one’s own passion, to conquer one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 109b:12">B. Bath. 109ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>בנות פ̇וט̇יאל</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 6:25">Ex. VI, 25</cite>) <he>דאתי מיוסף שפ׳ ביצרו</he> Elazar was a descendant of Joseph, who (is surnamed Putiel, because he) conquered his passion; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 7">Ex. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>שהיתה אשתו … יוסף שפ׳ ביצרו … שפ̇יט̇ם וכ׳</he> his wife was a descendant of two families, being on one side of the tribe of Joseph who conquered his passion, and on the other of the family of Jethro who fattened &., v. <cite ref="Q00535"><he>פָּטַם</he></cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 43a">Sot. 43ᵃ</cite>
